high_findings.detail: scan_secrets_in_evidence credential_assignment regex misses JSON quoted keys ("api_key": "..."); substring pattern:api_key still hits. Do not rely on credential_assignment alone for JSON evidence.
Windows may deny symlink creation without privilege; campaign marks symlink mutants equivalent/platform_skip. Re-run on symlink-capable host before treating symlink jail as production-proven.
Mutations are in-memory weakened subjects, not AST edits of production modules. Surviving source-level mutants outside owned wrappers remain a coverage gap for future mutmut/cosmic-ray integration.
